WeddingRsvp.title: WeddingRsvp
WeddingRsvp.description: A wedding RSVP and blessing submitted directly by any guest or family for Vinayak & Ruchi's wedding without requiring login.

guestName.description: Full name or family name of the guest(s) attending.

phone.description: Optional contact phone number provided by the guest.

guestsCount.description: Total number of guests attending (1 to 20).

events.description: List of 1 to 4 wedding ceremonies the guest plans to attend.

blessing.description: Optional blessing or arrival message for Vinayak & Ruchi.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the RSVP was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the RSVP was last updated.

WeddingAdmin.title: WeddingAdmin
WeddingAdmin.description: Authorized wedding host or family coordinator who can view and manage all guest RSVPs.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the co-host admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the co-host.

role.description: Role within the wedding host team.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/rsvps/{rsvpId}.description: Allows any wedding guest to create an RSVP without logging in; reading, updating, and deleting RSVPs is restricted to verified wedding hosts.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores co-host admin privileges for viewing all wedding RSVPs.
